newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofwat says water cos' dividends unsustainable.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofwat says water cos' dividends unsustainable.

text.p: British water industry regulator Ofwat said on Thursday that water companies' dividend payouts were "unsustainable".
Byatt's comments came after the water industry watchdog said it was considering a one-off price cut at its next review, due in 1999.
Byatt has been a staunch critic of water firms' dividend increases, arguing that hefty payouts could undermine investment programmes.
Byatt said some companies had taken note of his comments on dividends, but others had not.
He urged water firms to explain more carefully how their dividends were derived, adding that the payouts must be reasonable.
"If not, I would be ready to consider licence changes to make them explain...Some need to examine their consciences on that matter," he said.
Britain's new Labour government has laid down a 10-point plan for water companies to deal with the current drought, including mandatory targets to cut leaks.
It has also vowed to levy a one-off tax on privatised utilities' profits as part of its first budget on July 2. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
